title: Day-Count Convention for Emergency Supplies — Worked Calendar
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — emergency supplies of a drug turned away at the counter for prior authorization.** The counted emergency supply days, once the one-day floor has been applied to them as a whole, are turned into dispensed days by the day-count convention.

**Convention.** The day-count convention follows who started the latest request for the drug. Where the member started it, the counted days are business days with today as the first day, so the dispensed days are the counted days plus two days for every Saturday and Sunday pair that falls before the counted business days run out. Where the pharmacy started it, the counted days are calendar days with today as the first day, and a supply whose last calendar day falls on a Saturday runs two more days to the Monday while one whose last day falls on a Sunday runs one more day to the Monday. Where the prescriber started it, the counted days are calendar days and are dispensed as counted.

The latest request for the drug is the most recently received prior authorization or exception request for the drug named on the latest counter rejection for prior authorization; who started it is shown on the request as the member, the pharmacy or the prescriber. A business week is the 5 days Monday through Friday.

### Method table

| Latest request started by | Unit of the counted days | Dispensed days |
|---|---|---|
| The member | Business days, today as day 1 | Counted days plus 2 for each Saturday and Sunday pair passed before the last counted business day |
| The pharmacy | Calendar days, today as day 1 | Counted days; plus 2 if the last day is a Saturday, plus 1 if it is a Sunday |
| The prescriber | Calendar days | Counted days as they stand |

### Worked calendar (hypothetical)

| Started by | Today | Counted days | Where the count ends | Dispensed days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member | Monday | 5 | Friday; no weekend passed | 5 |
| Member | Wednesday | 4 | Monday; one weekend passed | 6 |
| Member | Friday | 9 | Wednesday of the second week; two weekends passed | 13 |
| Pharmacy | Thursday | 3 | Saturday, rolled to Monday | 5 |
| Pharmacy | Friday | 3 | Sunday, rolled to Monday | 4 |
| Pharmacy | Monday | 3 | Wednesday | 3 |
| Prescriber | Thursday | 3 | Saturday; no roll | 3 |
